application_boundary: Unified enterprise distribution, financial accounting, workforce, customer relationships and shared application capabilities.
input_revision_policy: The inspected development snapshot is fixed; later changes are not automatically part of this specification. All required contract definitions are published here.

capability_groups.name: shared_application_capabilities
capability_groups.responsibility: Records, values, identity, permissions, transactions, workflow, communication, background work and extension composition.

capability_groups.name: enterprise_business_capabilities
capability_groups.responsibility: Accounting, sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, assets, projects, service and regional behavior.

capability_groups.name: workforce_capabilities
capability_groups.responsibility: Employment, attendance, leave, recruitment, benefits, payroll, expenses and advances.

capability_groups.name: customer_relationship_capabilities
capability_groups.responsibility: Lead and deal management, contacts, activities, enrichment and commercial integration.

scope_rules: Capability groups are navigation boundaries, not required deployment units.
Supporting acceptance checks are distinguished from production business capabilities.
Historical upgrade utilities and vendor-specific deployment choices are excluded from rebuilding requirements.
Optional counterpart applications are represented by their required boundary contracts, not invented internal implementations.
integration_execution_status: The combined development configuration and a replacement application have not been executed as complete systems.
